retina.description: Render at the display's physical resolution (Wine Retina mode) instead of its point size, which macOS then upscales: 3840x2160 instead of 1920x1080 on a 4K panel at the default scaling.

srgb.description: Colour-managed output: mtld3d tags frames as sRGB (color.space = accurate), so a wide-gamut panel shows the art's intended hues instead of stretching them to the panel's gamut.

retina-srgb.description: Both: physical resolution and colour-managed output.
